scope: Selected public statements useful when preparing an owner inquiry. Not comprehensive, not buyer verification, not acceptance or valuation.
maintenance: Recheck primary sources before use. A snapshot older than 30 days is stale; do not silently change its review date.

routes.name: Patronus AI
routes.route_type: direct buyer, according to its partner page

material.statement: Private codebases with development history and supporting context such as pull requests, issues and documentation; older systems still used to run a business are an example of interest.

review.statement: Public sample terms describe an NDA before sharing, a named scope and evaluation-only use. The code sample is a buildable snapshot with the last twelve months of history.

owner_payment.statement: The public process says full review takes up to 30 days and the owner is paid directly on acceptance. These are published process statements, not a guarantee for a particular submission.

introducer_payment.statement: 15% of the license fee after the owner is paid, subject to the partner agreement. Separate from the owner's compensation.

routes.publisher_relationship: Data Ledger's guide uses a disclosed referral link. No paid referral outcome is claimed.

routes.name: Pangea.ai code licensing

material.statement: The public referral page describes real production source code with Git history, selected owned repositories, excluding client work and NDA-restricted material, and redacting sensitive material before submission.

owner_payment.statement: Published owner-rate examples are illustrative rather than quotes; actual amounts depend on codebase valuation and buyer demand.

introducer_payment.statement: The referral page advertises 15% of what a referred owner is paid, including future re-licences, within 15 days after fees are paid out. This is contingent on an actual paid licence and applicable terms.

routes.publisher_relationship: No Data Ledger Pangea referral is asserted in this snapshot.

change_history.change: Initial public-source snapshot. Published claims and unknowns kept separate.
